get.summary: Gets a specific tool by name.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt / instructions for the agent's LLM.

modelProviderId.description: Model Provider ID. Required for System agents, optional for External agents.

extra.description: JSON object for additional external agent settings.

AgentUpdateRequest.description:
Updates an agent. External agents support partial updates for displayName, description,
modelProviderId, extra, and environmentVariables only. When supplied for an External agent,
displayName and description cannot be null.

uri.description: A data URI representing the content.

AgwMessage.description: AI message with role, author, and content blocks.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MCP server (e.g., "github-mcp").

command.description:
Command to launch the MCP server process (stdio transport only).
Examples: "dnx", "npx", "python"

arguments.description:
Arguments for the command (stdio transport only).
Example: ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-github"]

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for the stdio process.

environmentVariables.description:
Environment variables for the stdio process.
Values may reference secrets using {{secret:key_name}} syntax.

headers.description: HTTP headers for HTTP/SSE transport (e.g., auth tokens).

enabled.description: Whether this server is enabled for tool discovery and agent use.

name.description: Gets the name of the tool (method name or custom name).

description.description: Gets the description of the tool.

category.description: Gets the category of the tool for grouping purposes.

typeName.description: Gets the full type name of the class containing the tool.

parameters.description: Gets the parameters of the tool.

isAsync.description: Gets whether this is an asynchronous tool.

requiresConfirmation.description: Gets whether this tool requires user confirmation before execution.

timeoutMs.description: Gets the execution timeout in milliseconds.

ToolInfo.description: Represents a selectable Tool or Tool Block in the Tools catalog.

name.description: Gets the name of the parameter.

type.description: Gets the type of the parameter.

description.description: Gets the description of the parameter.

isOptional.description: Gets whether the parameter is optional.

defaultValue.description: Gets the default value for the parameter if it has one.

schemaType.description: Gets the JSON schema type hint (e.g., "string", "number", "boolean").

enumValues.description: Gets allowed enum values if applicable.

ToolParameterInfo.description: Represents information about a parameter of a tool.
